# Dishant Modh

> Senior Database Reliability Engineer at The Walt Disney Company (since July 2026). 5+ years across PostgreSQL, Amazon Aurora, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, Snowflake, AWS and Terraform. Based in Bengaluru, India.
